source: The Made Real Blueprint - Introduction v5.docx, "Your route" (three phases, eight steps)
title: The whole road
intro: Three phases, eight steps. Each step answers one big question and gives you a practical result to work with.

phases.name: Choose it
phases.says: Decide honestly what you want, and where. Deciding not to move is a real choice too.

phases.name: Build it
phases.says: Put the foundations in place, then build your life in Portugal.

phases.name: Live it
phases.says: Settle into everyday life and keep checking that it works for you.

two_outcomes: Steps 1 to 3 work for any destination, including staying where you are. If you decide to stay, you leave with a clear plan to change your life at home. If you decide to move, Steps 4 to 8 guide you through building your new life in Portugal.
